title: Family Christmas Gathering, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: This was Carl & Herb having a chat over their shirts.
description: A candid 1950s black and white snapshot capturing a mid-century family gathered in a living room on Christmas morning. A decorated Christmas tree sits elevated on a draped table bordered by a miniature white picket fence with a Santa Claus decoration below. Two men, identified as Carl and Herb, sit together discussing newly unwrapped gift shirts while family members open presents nearby.
